Subject: Your wrongful termination matter

Dear Mr. Bhosale,

Thank you for meeting us on 27 August 2020 about your dispute with M/s Srivastava Industries. As we understand it, the employer offered to settle.

Our advice is to negotiate a settlement of gratuity and notice pay. Please collect the salary slips and the gratuity calculation and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹44,60,000.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
